messages:
marta: RCA published for the 2026-03-18 inference degradation — https://redwood-internal.company/rca/1723509876 :link:

marta: TL;DR: a subtle mismatch in tokenizer handling during a model swap caused ~1.7% request failures and elevated tail latency for 45m. Root cause: an earlier tokenizer regression slipped past the staging eval because of a skewed test prompt set.

marta: Immediate mitigation applied: reverted model variant and rolled forward a hotfix to the tokenizer normalization step. Customer impact: a handful of production customers saw degraded responses; support escalations were opened and triaged.

marta: High-level action items (owners & soft deadlines):
```
- sam: add tokenizer regression unit tests + gated eval (due 2026-03-25)
- raj: add runtime check to detect tokenizer-model mismatch and fallback (due 2026-03-22)
- oliver: publish customer communication summary & update support playbook (due 2026-03-20)
- marta: schedule 48h and 14d follow-up checkpoints and confirm rollout policy changes (due 2026-03-19)
```

marta: Follow-up cadence: 48-hour quick check to confirm mitigations + 14-day validation for eval coverage and model onboarding checklist changes. I've created a recurring Monday sync for owners to report progress.

amelia: Thanks — can product get a short blurb we can use for the status page? Also want to understand whether this affects cached embeddings.

marta: @amelia short answer: embeddings cache not affected because the issue was in tokenization used during decoding only. I'll DM a short blurb you can reuse.

raj: I'll take the runtime check. Plan is to add a lightweight header in requests that indicates tokenizer-version and fail open with an alert to SREs. Will PR today.

sam: Taking the unit tests and gated eval work. I'll add a small corpus that mimics production prompt patterns and a CI job that runs on model changes.

oliver: I'll draft the customer note and coordinate with CS. Rough ETA EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: incident-channel #incident-1723509876 created by marta — archive scheduled in 30d.

marta: Thanks all. If you pick up any of the listed items but need to shift deadlines, update the action tracker in the doc and ping me. Planning an office hours session Friday 10:00 PST to walk through the RCA and Q/A. :calendar:
